domainA.operator: Kilo AI (commercial gateway; free anonymous tier)
domainA.metering: provider request/token windows behind one public egress identity
domainA.independence: one group per public egress identity

domainB.metering: account concurrency (500 max parallel generations) + queue priority; no request/token budget
domainB.independence: one global pool keyed by the anonymous Horde account identity (account id 0)

independenceRationale: Different operators: Kilo AI commercial gateway vs Haidra community worker network.
Different quota ownership: per-egress-IP budget vs one global anonymous account (shared:ai-horde).
Different metering dimensions: request/token windows vs standing concurrency.

Different failure domains proven live: R65-CROSS-DOMAIN-FAILOVER.json records two ROTATE receipts from kilo-free-direct to ai-horde after kilo quota exhaustion, with completion served entirely by the second domain.
